title: Hybrid LLM-Deterministic Pipelines for Enterprise-Scale Code Migration at Bloomberg
abstract: arXiv:2611.05457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large organizations carry a long tail of infrastructure migrations that are worth doing but rarely urgent enough to compete with feature work, because each one costs significant engineering time per repository. This paper reports on our industrial experience from Automated Uplift, a multi-month initiative applying LLM-assisted migration pipelines across thousands of Bloomberg repositories. We examine two distinct production campaigns: a heterogeneous Python packaging migration (approx. 1,900 candidate repositories) and a uniform C++ build system migration (approx. 6,700 candidate repositories). Together, these campaigns generated 2,333 pull requests, resulting in 729 successful migrations. translated_title: 彭博（Bloomberg）企业级代码迁移中的混合 LLM-确定性流水线
translated_abstract: 大型组织中存在着大量基础设施迁移的长尾工作，这些工作值得做但往往不够紧迫，难以与功能开发竞争优先级，因为每项迁移在每个代码仓库上都需要耗费大量的工程时间。本文报告了我们从“Automated Uplift（自动提升）”计划中获得的工业实践经验，这是一项历时数月的计划，在彭博的数千个代码仓库中应用了 LLM 辅助的迁移流水线。我们考察了两个不同的生产环境迁移行动：一个异构的 Python 打包迁移（约 1,900 个候选仓库）和一个统一的 C++ 构建系统迁移（约 6,700 个候选仓库）。这些行动总共生成了 2,333 个拉取请求，最终实现了 729 次成功的迁移。我们详细介绍了我们的混合架构解决方案：该方案最大化确定性处理，将 LLM 的使用限定在预先计算好的上下文中执行有界的文件转换，并引入了运行时生产遥测数据（如执行日志和使用轨迹等）。
tldr: 彭博提出的混合 LLM-确定性流水线架构，通过将 LLM 限定在预计算上下文内进行有界文件转换并结合生产遥测反馈，在约 8,600 个企业仓库的两大迁移行动中实现了 729 次成功代码迁移。
en_tdlr: Bloomberg's hybrid LLM-deterministic pipeline architecture confines LLMs to bounded file transformations within pre-computed contexts and leverages production telemetry, achieving 729 successful code migrations across two large-scale campaigns covering approximately 8,600 enterprise repositories.
